verdict.rationale: Square documents an API Explorer, which lets users call Square APIs directly to test their capabilities and act on objects in a Square account. That is an interactive, runnable API reference. The isolated Sandbox lets those calls run safely without affecting real data. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the reference's per-endpoint runnable examples and code generation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API Explorer experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: You can call Square APIs directly from [API Explorer](https://developer.squareup.com/explorer/square) to test their capabilities and perform actions on objects within a Square account.
The Square Sandbox is a free, isolated server environment that allows developers to safely test Square APIs without affecting real data.
